args.prompt: The pager buzzes; FAST's thumb taps his own chest at the frame edge on 'That's me'. The approved pager close-up: green LCD 'KARPATHY:' / 'NO THINKING. SINGLE TOKEN. LOW LATENCY'. Camera: Extreme close-up. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, saturated colors, energetic limited animation with smear frames, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
